narrative: 这个镜头是一个不需要移动就能收拢的念头。空间关系保持不变，因此观众感觉自己被注视或分析，而不是被靠近。
脸在变大，墙壁之间的相对关系不变，压迫感完全来自光学层面。当注意力需要收窄、而房间又不能重新排列时使用它。
如果你需要通过占据同一片空气来进入一个念头，那么这就不是合适的工具：那项任务属于真实的靠近运动，因为变焦从不改变摄影机的机位。
how: 锁定一个沉重的三脚架。保持高度、俯仰角和节点位置不变。
在数秒内平滑地推动焦距变化，并预先排练好随着景深变浅而需要的对焦补偿。压缩感不断增强：远处的层次看起来离主体更近了，尽管没有任何东西真正移动过。
提示词：锁定的摄影机机身，渐进的光学变焦推近，压缩感不断增强，明确禁止出现推轨式的视差。
when: 用它在建筑空间保持不变的前提下，对一个静止的人物施加压力。具体场景：一支监控用的长焦镜头，缓慢地在人群中孤立出一个人。
如果前景物体必须产生剥离，以证明摄影机真的移动过，就不要用它。
vs: 推轨推进（Dolly In）让整台摄影机位移，因此前景和背景的速度会发生变化。推镜头（Push In）则是一次物理或虚拟的靠近，任务是让一次顿悟落地。
急推变焦（Crash Zoom In）使用同样的光学机制，但速度快如惊悚点。当机位绝对不能移动时，就用慢速变焦推近。
examples_film: 《窃听大阴谋》（The Conversation）用渐进的长焦拉近，在联合广场上孤立出人物。《血色将至》（There Will Be Blood）和《魅影缝匠》（Phantom Thread）用缓慢的光学收紧来表现耐心与审视。
这些是机身锁定式压缩感的语法范本，而不是要照搬的画面。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是推轨推进，或者把数码裁切包装成变焦。破绽在于视差：如果前景中的一把椅子相对于墙壁产生了滑动，说明你做的是位移。
解决办法：锁定机头，真正改变焦距，并在最终的紧景画面上保持不动。

faq.q: 电影中的慢速变焦推近（Slow Zoom In）是什么？
faq.a: 它是在摄影机支撑装置保持不动的情况下，逐渐增加焦距。画面收紧、空间被压缩，但摄影机并没有占据新的位置。

faq.q: 慢速变焦推近（Slow Zoom In）与推轨推进（Dolly In）的区别
faq.a: 推轨推进让摄影机真正移动，因此透视关系和视差都会变化。慢速变焦推近则只是“移动”镜头本身：大小在变化，而各层次之间的相对几何关系保持不变。

faq.q: 什么时候该用慢速变焦推近（Slow Zoom In）？
faq.a: 当你想要压迫感、审视感，或一次缓慢的孤立效果，并且需要房间保持同一个空间时使用。如果这一拍实际上是要进入这个空间，就跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写慢速变焦推近（Slow Zoom In）的提示词？
faq.a: 说明锁定的三脚架、光学变焦推近、持续时长，以及机身不移动。示例：camera body locked, lens slowly zooming in for 6 seconds, compression increasing, no dolly.

narrative: The shot is a thought that closes without walking. Geography stays put, so the audience feels watched or analyzed rather than approached.
Faces grow, walls stay in the same relation, and the pressure is optical. Use it when attention must narrow and the room must not rearrange itself.
It is the wrong tool when you need to enter a mind by occupying the same air: that job belongs to a physical approach, because a zoom never changes the camera's station point.
how: Lock a heavy tripod. Keep height, tilt, and nodal point still.
Drive focal length smoothly over several seconds and rehearse focus compensation as depth of field shallows. Compression increases: distant planes look closer to the subject even though nobody moved.
Prompt a locked camera body, a gradual optical zoom in, rising compression, and an explicit ban on dolly parallax.
when: Use it to raise pressure on a still figure while the architecture stays legally the same. Concrete beat: a surveillance long-lens slowly isolating one person in a crowd.
Do not use it if foreground objects must peel and prove the camera walked.
vs: A Dolly In translates the whole camera, so foreground and background change speed. A Push In is a physical or virtual walk whose job is a realization landing.
A Crash Zoom In uses the same optical mechanism at sting speed. Stay on slow zoom in when the station point must not move.
examples_film: The Conversation isolates figures in Union Square with a gradual long-lens close. There Will Be Blood and Phantom Thread use slow optical tightening as patience and scrutiny.
These are grammar for locked-body compression, not frames to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly In or a digital crop sold as a zoom. The tell is parallax: if a foreground chair slides against the wall, you translated.
The fix is a locked head, a true focal-length change, and a hold on the final tight frame.

faq.q: What is Slow Zoom In in film?
faq.a: It is a gradual increase of focal length with the camera support still. The image tightens and space compresses, but the camera does not occupy a new position.

faq.q: Slow Zoom In vs Dolly In
faq.a: Dolly in walks the camera so perspective and parallax change. Slow zoom in only walks the lens: size grows, relative geometry of planes stays the same.

faq.q: When should I use Slow Zoom In?
faq.a: When you want pressure, scrutiny, or a slow isolation and you need the room to remain the same place. Skip it if the beat is actually entering the space.

faq.q: How do I prompt Slow Zoom In for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name a locked tripod, optical zoom in, duration, and no body travel. Example: camera body locked, lens slowly zooming in for 6 seconds, compression increasing, no dolly.
